item.title: PlayStation confirms GTA 6 had 39 million unique players in 4 days. For perspect…
item.description: PlayStation confirms GTA 6 had 39 million unique players in 4 days. For perspective, 100 million PS5 consoles have been sold so far, meaning more than a third have already played the game. It reportedly sold 45 million copies across all platforms and grossed over $4 billion in 4 days, according to Alinea Analytics. @RockstarGames 😠
